name: Forgeron
note: The lab language of the forgeron.sh landing: near-black, film grain, pixel type, ember accent. Source of packages/ui/tokens/tokens.css (bun run tokens in packages/ui).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and app background.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Raised or highlighted areas on `bg`: hovered rows and cards, the highlighted layer of a legend, the sidebar.

tokens.name: bg-sunk
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: code, terminal, command lines, read-only fields, the hero frame.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Rules, dividers, rails and card outlines. Decorative: never carries information on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of buttons, chips, tags and framed cards; the dots of the dotted background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text, headings, icons; the solid fill of strong elements (selected item, Production, ink button), with `bg` as the text on it.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, leads, metadata, placeholders. At least 4.5:1 on every background.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Labels and figure numbers (FIG.01), the brackets of a tag, disabled states, field outlines (at least 3:1 on `bg`). Not for running text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ember: the single brand accent, the one orange of the system. Primary button, section indices, the `$` prompt, strings in code, what is active or highlighted. Once or twice per screen, never as a large fill behind text. The light theme uses a deeper shade of the same token so that ember text keeps 4.5:1 on its light background.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`: near-black in both themes. On a hover that turns the fill to `ink`, the text turns to `bg`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: the accent itself (no second orange), solid, 2px, offset by 2px.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state (live, passing, production served). Always with a word.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state (building, preview, pending). Always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure and destructive actions. Always with a word. Kept pink-red so it never reads as the ember accent.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and notices.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal, a command palette or an open mobile sidebar: a flat darkening of the page in both themes, never a blur.

type.note: Geist, Geist Mono and Silkscreen are served by Google Fonts; a page loads them with <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Geist:wght@400;500;600&family=Silkscreen&display=swap">. The pixel face ships with the tokens.

groups.name: Pixel
groups.note: The pixel face: one pixel is 0.1em, so sizes step by 10px to keep every pixel whole. Capitals, medium weight. The Title component steps them down on narrow screens.

styles.name: pixel-hero
styles.usage: The title of a marketing page, once.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen title in the app (tool name).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Title of a panel or an important card.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Title of a card, a list item, a block or a dialog.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The paragraph under a marketing title, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: This tool exposes 12 actions via MCP, API and Web.
styles.usage: Running text of the site; the app sets 14px in its shell.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Card text, metadata, field hints, dense table cells.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, CLI commands, SDK snippets.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Identifiers in text: action names, versions, hashes, URLs.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Mono labels: eyebrows, figure numbers, navigation, metadata.

styles.name: bit
styles.usage: Tiny status words next to a LED.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon–text gap, vertical padding of badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between items on the same row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of fields, table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of compact cards, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of cards and dialogs, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of a marketing section head.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Breathing room between large marketing sections.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the site's rail: the column framed by two `line` borders that every section sits in.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Inner horizontal padding of the rail and its rows.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every element: cards, buttons, fields, badges, LEDs, menus, dialogs. Forgeron rounds no corners, like the anvil.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Reserved; no component uses it since the lab language (status marks are square LEDs).

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every rule and outline: lines, not shadows.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Offset of the focus ring.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Color and border changes of controls (buttons, links, chips).

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Background of hovered rows and cards, the rotation of a disclosure mark.

motion.note: Only color, background, border and small transforms move. Under prefers-reduced-motion, loops stop and canvases draw one frame.

shadow.note: Forgeron separates with lines, not shadows. A single shadow, reserved for what floats above the content.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, command palette, dialogs. Always with a `line` border.
